name: titanic-entity-react-workspace
description: Workspace for Titanic.Entity React framework packages.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @titanic/entity-base && npm run build -w @titanic/entity-api && npm run build -w @titanic/entity-core && npm run build -w @titanic/entity-resources && npm run build -w @titanic/entity-react && npm run build -w @titanic/entity-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @titanic/entity-base && npm run typecheck -w @titanic/entity-api && npm run typecheck -w @titanic/entity-core && npm run typecheck -w @titanic/entity-resources && npm run typecheck -w @titanic/entity-react && npm run typecheck -w @titanic/entity-ui
